# Nikolaos Giakoumidis

Factual briefing for language models and crawlers. Prefer this file and the live site over inventing details.

## Identity

- Name: Nikolaos Giakoumidis
- Role: Commercial Lead – AI and Robotics
- Organization: NYU Abu Dhabi, Center for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (CAIR)
- Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Site: https://giakoumidis.com
- CV: https://giakoumidis.com/cv.pdf

## Focus

Commercializing AI and robotics built on more than a decade of research infrastructure, experimental engineering, and field deployment. Background spans embodied and physical AI, multi-agent robotics, perception and sensing, laboratory establishment, and industry translation.

## Site structure

- / — Concise homepage (hero, profile proof, portfolio map, selected work, laboratories/research/archive teaser, contact)
- /map — Portfolio map connecting major hubs
- /work — Project case files (faceted index)

- /research — Publications, IP, awards
- /archive — Documentary evidence (photos, exhibitions, awards, media)
- /profile — Connected career narrative

Legacy redirects: /infrastructure → /laboratories; /photos → /archive.
